name: Lockup close card
looks: On a flat or softly gradient brand-colour ground, the mark and wordmark settle together, a short tagline fades in under it, and a small pill-shaped CTA button arrives last and holds. Nothing moves once it's all in place.
build: Mark and wordmark arrive as one group (y: 8-12px -> 0, opacity 0 -> 1, power2.out, 300-400ms). Tagline fades in 150-200ms after. CTA pill arrives last 150-200ms later with a touch of scale overshoot (0.95 -> 1.02 -> 1).
sound: A soft low swell that fades out under the hold, no new hits once the pill lands.
prompt: Close on a flat or softly gradient brand-colour card: settle the mark and wordmark together, fade in a short tagline under it, then land a small pill CTA last with a touch of overshoot, and hold there without further motion.
